evidence.reason: Moved the disposable-guest confinement check (hostname == crq-probe) out of phase_prepare() and activators_install() into main() before phase dispatch, so every phase — including activators-positive's repair_clean() that stops the crq-repair service/timer/path units — is refused outside the disposable guest before any phase function runs; tests were not run locally (git-only harness), CI remains the authority.
